checks: Offline guard negative control and finite fake-cycle lifecycle checks; see model.md#tests
cost: Startup O(source bytes + queue bytes), source/index retained in memory. Per job includes bounded context, GPU witnesses and one small teacher batch; campaign disk traversal adds O(total files) per job. No throughput improvement claimed.
description: An immutable snapshot and queue are joined by IDs and source hashes; batches of at most eight queue entries are reserved before one isolated cycle. Accepted, refused, missing and uncertain results are distinct. Durable receipts precede advancing the logical cursor; prior receipts are skipped only under the pinned campaign identity.

inverse: behavior_complement: excluded, oversized, invalid or unreserved states cannot be counted as completed accepted work.
reverse_reconstruction: a receipt and pinned identities constrain compatible inputs and outcomes, but do not uniquely reconstruct hidden model computation or interrupted process histories.
limitations: Audit controller and transport boundaries; source-derived partial model. Fake local child checks are finite evidence, not a proof of semantic annotation quality or general crash recovery.
state: Audit-only; outputs isolated; no automatic production training or promotion.
